So far this app is the closest I’ve found to what I’m looking for! I was not looking for an app with features like shopping for dog products, searching for groomers, etc. I just wanted a way to accurately log and track my dog’s vaccinations, medical records, food rotations, etc. This app is great for that! While it’s fairly basic, it does what I need it to and it’s not glitchy. For it being a free app, I’m very happy with it so far. I especially enjoy the reminders for logging when a vaccine is due, adding family members so my boyfriend is kept in the loop, and the option to filter for certain “events” on your timeline. The filter feature came in handy recently when I filtered for an event category I created called “Symptoms” and was able to see exactly when my dog started showing symptoms of a possible eye infection to share those details with the vet. Still, I do have a few suggestions for the developers that I think would improve the user experience.   1. Ability to reorder the fields in the pet’s profile (such as by holding them down to reorder, or by giving the option to move a field up or down in the order). Ex: I added my dog’s vet info, doggy daycare info, microchip #, and then realized I should add the vet’s phone number as a field too. I was unable to move the new vet phone # field up with the rest of the vet info and had to delete my other fields and re-enter them after the phone number to group the vet info together.   2. Ability to click “Return” to enter to a new line within the typing box in the “Add a field” section. Right now, clicking “Return” on the keyboard saves the field and there is no way to click enter to add info on a new line within the same field.   3. Ability to upload pictures to an event. I recently tracked some symptoms on my dog over a few days that I thought could indicate the beginning of an eye infection. It would be nice to be able to upload pictures with each event to track the changes.   4. Exporting the data as a user-friendly PDF. As of now, when you export the data from your account, it is formatted as text only (no organization, difficult to decipher, and looks like something out of a coding textbook). It would be super helpful if the app developers created a PDF layout that inputs all of your pet’s profile info, events, and progress pictures in an organized format when exporting the information. That way a copy could be emailed or printed to give the vet so they can get accurate information. I currently give my vet an updated print out at each visit listing my dog’s food, treats, toppers/supplements and symptoms dated in chronological order, so being able to export that data would save me a TON of time! I would pay for a “premium” version of the app to be able to export my dog’s info in this way.
